origin.description: Classify with uniform, optimal, and bagged neighbor weights.
origin.usage: ownn(train, test, cl, testcl=NULL, k=NULL, prob=FALSE, algorithm=c("kd_tree", "cover_tree", "brute"))
origin.details: k is required. The R default draws a random fold, so this translation does not choose k by sampling.
origin.example: ownn on the six-point train and the two test points, k=2

translation.description: ownn requires k. It reports the uniform, optimal-weight, and bagged predictions.
translation.usage: ownn(train, test, cl, testcl=None, k=None, prob=False, algorithm=None)
translation.details: k is required. The R default draws a random fold, so this translation does not choose k by sampling.
translation.example: ownn on the six-point train and the two test points, k=2
